name: botwire-mcp
description: The Bot Wire as MCP tools: 40 real-time data wires for AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex CLI). Primary sources, not a crawler index: SEC EDGAR, the Federal Reserve, BLS/BEA economic data, federal courts, Congress, the White House, DOJ, FDA, WHO/CDC, European Commission, GOV.UK, Pentagon, CISA/CVEs, USGS earthquakes, NWS weather alerts, arXiv, bioRxiv, NASA, plus news, markets, world, tech, crypto, energy, supply chain, open-source releases, gaming, film, music and remote jobs. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base), free preview on every wire, no API key or signup.
author: The Bot Wire (https://thebotwire.com)
